All of the fronds grow from one base at the lower left of the clump and sweep toward the right side of the image in one shared direction, as if one stroke of a comb had swept the whole plant: the tall central fronds, the shorter left-hand fronds, and the young fiddleheads all lean and curl rightward. Each frond arcs gently to the right with natural variation in length and curvature, long fronds reaching far right, short fronds reaching a little right. Small fiddleheads at the base tightly curl rightward. Strong value contrast between the pale midribs and the dark green blades carries the silhouette against any ground.
